closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**问题范围澄清（报告人于 2026-10-31 确认）**

本问题关注：**手机网络和云端连接正常，任务已经提交，但任务执行失败时，客户端没有说明具体失败原因，只显示通用失败/重试提示。**

原正文将截图解读为“重试重复写入用户消息”，没有准确表达报告人的主要诉求；该解释不再作为本 issue 的主问题和验收标准。此前的重试去重测试不能当作本问题已经解决。

复现路径：
1. 手机保持正常联网，在 DigitalMate 主对话提交一个普通问答或工具任务。
2. 出现真实任务执行失败时，查看聊天里的失败提示和活动里的任务状态。
3. 对比用户可见提示与任务实际失败原因；网络无异常时，不应只要求检查网络或反复重试。

实际结果：
- 用户无法知道是执行超时、服务暂不可用、模型鉴权/额度/限流、工具调用失败，还是本轮没有生成有效回答。
- 用户无法据此决定继续等、重试、修改请求，或等待服务修复。
- 通用“云端任务执行失败，请稍后重试；如持续出现，请联系服务管理员。”没有解释本次失败发生在哪一步。

补充的真实证据（非原截图的推断）：2026-10-31 在普通测试环境的主对话提交“顺序验证A-133135 / B-133135”，连接和历史读取成功，两任务的云端状态为 failed，结果为“这一轮结束了，但没有给出回答。”；正式 App 10059 均显示上述通用失败提示。该证据用于说明原因被泛化，不把本次异常泛称为手机断网，也不据此证明所有后台根因。

预期结果：
- 已确认的失败应给出简洁、可信的原因及下一步建议，例如“本次执行超时，尚未得到最终结果”或“本轮未生成有效回复”。
- 能确认鉴权、额度、限流或某个工具失败时，保留对应的用户可理解分类；不能统一丢失成“任务失败”。
- 原因尚不明确时，明确说“暂时无法确认具体原因”，不臆测为网络、账号或某一提供商的问题。
- 不把仍在运行、等待用户回答/授权、结果未知或用户主动停止，误报为任务失败。
- 展示原因和保留诊断信息分别处理，不把 Token、API Key、请求正文、服务器路径或堆栈暴露给用户。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：DigitalMate 手机端，`com.jiuwen.digitalmate`。
- 系统：HarmonyOS；原始截图的设备型号、系统版本未提供。
- 网络：报告人明确说明本问题发生时网络没有问题；断网不是必要复现条件。
- 原始反馈输入：“今年足球的金球奖是谁拿的”；原图保留在下方，但只证明原始聊天现场。
- 补充回归证据：`dm_phone` HarmonyOS 模拟器，普通测试云端 `1.94.211.46`；连接、主对话快照读取成功，任务执行失败。不是飞书隔离环境，也不是本地假后端。
- 云端实际运行镜像/模板版本：本补充证据未核实，不能用客户端源码版本代替服务端部署版本。

### Additional Information

**与已有问题的关系**

- #359 已包含“错误分类、具体原因和恢复指引”，可共用同一套失败分类及用户提示机制；本 issue 按报告人澄清聚焦“连接正常、已失败的任务没有原因”，不另建重复 issue、不并行做两套文案。
- #381 关注错误提示暴露内部组件/诊断细节；补原因时仍需遵守对用户友好的脱敏展示。
- #398 关注仍在运行但长时间没有事件的提示；运行中静默和已确认失败是不同状态。
- 重试去重是原正文记录的另一个现象，历史截图与评论保留；不把此前去重测试通过当成本 issue 新范围通过。

**当前源码核对（main @ 0fb04565，静态分析）**

1. `DigitalMateConversation.digitalmateTaskFailureText` 已区分部分额度、鉴权、限流和超时，但其他结果统一落入通用失败文案。像“这一轮结束了，但没有给出回答。”这样的已知任务结果也会被泛化。
2. 服务端 `_turn_failure_output` 会把部分模型异常转成简短说明，原始诊断只留日志；只在前端增加正则并不能恢复已经丢失的原因。
3. 因此建议在服务端失败边界保留稳定、可脱敏的错误分类，随任务状态传给客户端；聊天、活动、提醒使用同一映射。不是直接展示任意原始异常，也不只是替换一条通用文案。

**建议修复方向（待实现，不作为已修复声明）**

- 复用现有服务端失败分类，补齐超时、无有效回复、工具失败、模型鉴权/额度/限流、服务不可用和未知原因；以已确认事实分类。
- 任务协议携带可选的安全原因、发生阶段及恢复建议，旧服务/旧任务仍可兼容；底层诊断保留在日志并用诊断标识关联。
- 客户端统一呈现“原因 + 可执行建议”，已知分类不退回通用提示；未知原因如实说明，不让用户无意义反复重试。
- 不因错误文案变化修改原提问、删除失败记录或重复创建任务。

**验收与回归**

- [ ] 正常连接下，超时、无有效回复、工具失败等已确认场景显示对应原因及合理建议。
- [ ] 鉴权、额度、限流等现有分类不退化；未知原因不臆测为网络异常。
- [ ] 聊天、任务活动及提醒中的失败分类一致，原始提问及失败历史保留。
- [ ] 错误信息脱敏，普通回答中讨论错误码的内容不被误判为任务失败。
- [ ] 单元/协议集成测试覆盖分类、旧协议兼容及各状态边界；正式 App E2E 在正常连接下验证至少一种真实任务失败，截图能看到具体原因。
- [ ] 运行中静默、等待用户确认、用户停止与失败分别展示。

### Version Information

- 原始截图：App 版本未提供，截图记录为 2026-10-28；不补造构建号。
- 2026-10-31 补充截图：客户端 versionCode `10059`，源码 `3195c6b0f9aefdd510a4517de6eef7d3d644f308`（PR #389 修复分支，相关客户端代码已合入 main `0fb04565`）。
- 本次源码分析基于官方 main `0fb0456520f3fa3158ad14c6c1b4bf2981859722`，不代表本次已修改或部署了服务端。

### Screenshots / Recordings

**补充证据：10059 正式 App 主对话，两条真实任务失败均显示通用原因**

![真实任务失败仅显示通用错误，未说明本轮没有有效回复](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bd66a604b29b0c55feb93310d318ed8980105efa/evidence/issue339-native/cloud-20261031/cloud-main-B-result.jpeg?raw=true)

该图来自 2026-10-31 普通云端回归，原始模拟器截图、未经编辑，已在 PR #389 中使用；不是新构建或最新云端部署的验收截图。

**原始现场截图保留**

![原始重试现场；本图本身不证明网络故障或具体任务失败原因](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-28-retry-duplicate-user-message.jpg?raw=true)

closed_recent.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

DigitalMate 的工具调用与 MCP 链路存在多处**每次都发生的固定开销**：会话启动、文件交付、工具描述下发这几个环节都有可避免的重复工作。这些开销与用户任务无关，属于「不管做什么都要付的成本」，因此对每一轮对话、每一个任务都在累加。

2026-11-05 的对照实验（同一批任务，两次运行）测到的现象：

- 两项合成文件局部修改任务中，工具说明与目录提示导致模型**默认全量读取文件**（一次读回 88,410 字节 / 2000 行，而任务目标并不在该段落），并伴随路径试错与恢复调用；
- 累计输入 token 在两个完整配对组中由 **1,582,216 增至 1,878,641（+18.7%）**；主模型调用次数 52→46（次数下降但单次输入变大）。

需要说明的是：这 18.7% 只覆盖该批任务的路径/目录提示类修复，**不能**外推为通用提速（另补的一对账单为 +0.38%，未复现大范围默认读取，不足以推翻也不足以加强前面结论）。同一轮也确认没有 MCP 协议调用，因此本文不作为 MCP 性能收益证据。

针对上述固定开销，已提交 6 个独立修复 PR（标题均为 `perf(...)`，目标 main）：

| 修复 | PR | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| 同路径更新文件交付：按内容版本去重，避免每次重发未变文件 | [#574](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/574) | 已合并 |
| WorkSwarm 工具包公开导出按需解析，导入叶子不再初始化无关 SDK | [#580](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/580) | 待合并 |
| 文件交付校验不再初始化 SDK（helper 叶子加载、导入优先级） | [#576](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/576) | 已合并 |
| 工具进程绑定到声明式 Python 环境，避免继承错误 PATH | [#578](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/578) | 待合并 |
| agent-core 文件工具说明与实际执行契约对齐（相对路径、读前保护） | [#579](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/579) | 待合并 |
| 无项目场景目录提示明确当前工作目录 cwd，避免模型自行拼接任务根 | [#582](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/582) | 待合并 |

本 issue 用于统一跟踪这组性能修复的背景、边界与后续验收口径，避免各 PR 各自描述导致口径不一致。

### Design Ideas

按「消除固定开销」而非「换更快实现」的思路，分为四类：

1. **不重复做已经做过的事**：#574 记录每个会话/路径/目标集合最后成功交付的内容版本，内容未变则复用原结论，不再重新发送同一文件。#580 让工具包的公开导出在真正被访问时才解析，导入一个叶子模块不再牵连初始化整个 Agent SDK。

2. **不做与本次调用无关的初始化**：#576 让文件交付校验走轻量路径，不为了校验而拉起 SDK；#578 在导入任何 WorkSwarm 模块**之前**把工具命令绑定到声明的 Python 环境，避免子进程继承到错误的解释器后才发现。

3. **让模型少走弯路（减少无效往返）**：#579 让文件工具的说明与执行器实际强制的行为一致（相对路径基准、edit 前需先部分读、覆盖写前需完整读），模型不再靠试错发现规则；#582 让无项目场景的目录提示先给出权威 cwd，再说任务组织根目录，模型不必自己拼接路径。

4. **明确不采用的方案**：
   - 不通过放宽校验来换速度。所有修复都保持原有 fail-closed 行为（例如不可读取文件仍会被排除并如实上报，只是措辞与另一分支统一）；
   - 不引入新缓存层。当前所有「复用」都以已有事实为依据（内容哈希、显式配置），没有新增跨会话状态；
   - 保留 #574 中团队↔项目同名冲突的既有覆盖保护，不改为覆盖用户文件。

### Involved Public APIs

对外协议与公共接口**无变更**，均为内部实现与文案调整：

- #574/#576：交付结果的 JSON 结构不变；仅调整「未发送文件」的提示措辞，使部分交付与全部跳过两个分支一致（不可读取的文件不再被描述为「不存在」）。
- #580：`jiuwenswarm.agents.harness.common.tools` 的公开符号名、可选依赖回退行为保持不变，仅改变解析时机；调用方无感知。
- #578：新增环境变量 `DIGITALMATE_WORKSWARM_TOOL_PYTHON`（可选，未设置时行为与之前完全一致）；设置后要求为可执行文件的绝对路径，否则启动即失败并给出明确错误。
- #579：仅 agent-core 工具描述文本；执行器的校验与拒绝逻辑不变。
- #582：仅系统提示中的目录说明文本；路径解析、权限与文件系统保护不变。

来源完整性：以上改动涉及 vendored 源码（WorkSwarm / agent-core）时，同步更新了 `harness/UPSTREAM.json` 的 `import_overrides[].git_blob` 与 `imported_git_tree`，`python harness/verify_sources.py` 通过。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- **与 #577（重复「继续」导致 token 滚雪球）的关系**：互补但不同层。#577 处理的是「任务已完成仍全量重生成」的语义问题；本组处理的是「单次调用本身的固定开销」。两者可叠加，不重叠。
- **与 #223（TTFT 约 5s、含工具调用超 20s）的关系**：本组缩短的是工具链路的准备与无效往返，不改变模型推理与网络时延，因此**不能**用来解释或承诺 TTFT 改善。
- **与 #383 / #575（额度与余额）的关系**：固定开销下降会减少同任务的累计输入 token，间接影响配额消耗；但本组未做计费侧验证。
- **与 CI 门禁的关系**：本组未修改任何 workflow、门禁脚本、skip 配置或 Runner 配置。

### Test Design and Test Plan

已完成的验证（每个 PR 独立分支内）：

1. **来源完整性**：`python -B harness/verify_sources.py`，6 个 PR 均通过，重算后的 `imported_git_tree` 一致。
2. **单元与运行环境测试**：`harness/tests` 与相关模块套件在隔离 venv（Python 3.12/3.13）中运行通过；#574 为文件交付 19 项、#580 工具导出 4 项、#576 文件校验 8 项、#578 工具环境 6 项、#579 契约 6 项、#582 目录提示 4 项（含 cn/en 双语与 4 个本地渠道）。
3. **缺陷回归**：解冲突过程中发现并修复两处真实缺陷——#574 部分交付分支的错误措辞（新增断言，且在保留旧措辞的对照 worktree 上确认该断言会失败，证明确有区分度）；#582 在 main 新增的提示前缀测试与新分段结构下的适配。
4. **合并健康度**：6 个 PR 均已与最新 main 合并验证，`git merge-tree` 全部干净。

后续验收建议（尚未执行，需另行授权）：

1. **固定开销基线**：对同一组任务比较修复前后「工具准备阶段耗时」与「首次工具调用前的往返次数」，而非只看总耗时（总耗时受模型平台波动影响，不能作为代码效果证据）。
2. **重复交付抑制**：同一会话内重复请求未变更文件 N 次，断言实际传输次数为 1 且模型侧收到的结论一致。
3. **导入副作用**：仅导入 `tools` 叶子模块，断言未初始化无关 SDK 模块（可用 `sys.modules` 快照断言）。
4. **路径试错次数**：在无项目场景执行相对路径任务，断言路径错误与恢复调用次数为 0。
5. **不回归**：不可读取/特殊文件仍不得阻塞同批其余文件交付；授权失败后仍必须撤销已暂存资产并可重试。

### Additional Information

- 验证证据随各 PR 保存在 `docs/developer_guide/evidence/tool-mcp-fixes-2026-11-05/<topic>/` 下（含验证报表图），便于合并后在 Developer Guide 中追溯。
- 已知环境限制（非缺陷）：#574 的 `test_failed_authorized_delivery_revokes_assets_and_can_retry` 在 Windows 上于**未修改的原始 head** 同样失败，根因是清理资产时文件句柄未释放导致的 `OSError` 被吞掉，属既有 Windows 限制，不计为本组回归。
- 本组修复不改变模型选择、不调整提示中的任务内容，也不引入新的性能模型实验；上文引用的 +18.7% 仅用于说明动机与问题存在，不作为本组修复已达成该幅度收益的声明。

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] 已定位到具体代码位置与成因
- [ ] 同一 query 在两个环境的实际结果对比样本待补充

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：搜索链路没有区域概念。同一句中文 query 在内地测试环境打出去，拿回来的结果主要由**出口 IP 的地理位置**决定；而引擎池和请求参数都是写死的，代码里没有任何开关能把它纠正成"优先内地站点"。

**复现步骤**

1. 在内地测试环境（`wss://1.94.211.46/orbit/ws`）对话页发送：`请搜索下今天的A股情况`
2. 观察回答里引用的来源域名
3. 同一条 query 在香港现网再执行一次，对比来源域名分布

**实际结果**

代码层面可确定（已核对 v15 源码）：

| 位置 | 事实 |
|---|---|
| `orbit_free_search.py:26` | `Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9` 硬编码，中文 query 也按英文协商 |
| `orbit_free_search.py:268-272` | 引擎只有三个：`html.duckduckgo.com`、`r.jina.ai` 转的 DDG、`www.bing.com/search?q=` |
| 同上 | Bing URL **不带** `mkt` / `cc` / `setlang`，DDG **不带** `kl`，区域完全交给出口 IP 判定 |
| `orbit_free_search.py:224-233` | 只允许 `www.bing.com` / `cn.bing.com` 的区域跳转，被动等 Bing 自己 302 |
| `orbit_web_search.py:274-277` | `ORBIT_FREE_SEARCH_ENABLED=true` 时直接返回 `FreeSearch()`，`ORBIT_SEARCH_PROVIDER` 被忽略 |
| `orbit_config.py:130-134` | 配置项只有 provider / key / base_url，**没有区域或语种键** |

部署侧同样成立：v15 模板 env 为 `ORBIT_FREE_SEARCH_ENABLED=true`，未设 `ORBIT_SEARCH_PROVIDER` / `ORBIT_SEARCH_BASE_URL`，即当前测试环境走的就是这条 keyless 路径。

由此产生的可观察后果：

1. 内地财经、政务、新闻源（东方财富、新浪财经、财联社、同花顺、巨潮、gov.cn、新华网等）系统性缺位，结果混入香港/台湾/海外中文站与英文站
2. 两个环境结果不可复现——测试环境验过的效果，推到香港现网会变样
3. 引擎池里**没有任何内地引擎**（百度/搜狗/360 均未接入），即便区域参数配对，拿到的仍是 Bing 的索引
4. 内地环境里 DDG 两个变体通常不可达，每次先白等 `ENGINE_TIMEOUT_S=5s` 才落到 Bing，`TOTAL_TIMEOUT_S=18s` 预算被吃掉大半——这是 #315「概率性无法 web search」的一个直接成因

**期望结果**

- 搜索按部署区域行为可配：内地环境的中文 query 优先内地站点与内地引擎，香港/海外环境维持现状
- Bing/DDG 的请求带上明确的区域与语言参数（`mkt`/`cc`/`setlang`/`kl`），`Accept-Language` 跟随配置而不是常量
- 两个环境的行为差异是**配置差异**，而不是隐式的出口 IP 差异；同一个配置下结果可复现
- 若要求现网（香港）也拿到内地结果，需要搜索与抓取走内地出口——仅调参数不够

**影响**：行情、政策、国内时事这类强时效内容，用户拿到的是不同口径甚至不同来源的数据，属于正确性问题，不只是体验问题。同时让测试环境的验证结论无法平移到现网。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 测试环境：ADX 测试云，`wss://1.94.211.46/orbit/ws`，部署于内地
- 现网：部署于香港（部署方说明，本仓库内无法直接验证）
- Orbit 模板：`v15-workspace-20261028-a974262d1-8ed6d181-no-split`
- 模板 env：`ORBIT_FREE_SEARCH_ENABLED=true`，无 `ORBIT_SEARCH_PROVIDER` / `ORBIT_SEARCH_BASE_URL`
- App：`com.jiuwen.digitalmate` 0.1.0（versionCode 10006）

### Additional Information

**代码定位**

- `services/agent_bridge/src/orbit_bridge/orbit_free_search.py:26`、`:224-233`、`:263-310`
- `services/agent_bridge/src/orbit_bridge/orbit_web_search.py:274-277`、`:279-294`
- `services/agent_bridge/src/orbit_bridge/orbit_config.py:130-134`

**修复方向（供参考，非本 issue 结论）**

1. 新增 `ORBIT_SEARCH_REGION` / `ORBIT_SEARCH_LANGUAGE` 配置，映射到引擎的市场参数
2. 引擎池按区域排序，内地环境补入百度/搜狗等内地引擎（需处理反爬，且沿用现有的 HTTPS + 公开 IP + 重定向跳数限制）
3. 结果层对内地站点做排序加权（软偏好，不硬过滤）
4. 抓取（`fetch_webpage`）与搜索共用出口诉求——内地站点对海外 IP 的反爬/限流会让来源落地页打不开（#183）

**相关**

- #315（内地环境概率性无法 web search，本问题的成因之一）
- #183（周边检索 captcha/404）
- #326（来源链接渲染，结果集域名直接决定来源展示形态）

**待补充**

- 现网与测试环境的实际出口 IP 归属
- 同一 query 在两个环境的结果对比样本与域名分布统计

### Version Information

- 云端 Orbit 模板 `v15-workspace-20261028-a974262d1-8ed6d181-no-split`
- App 0.1.0 / versionCode 10006
- 源码基线：v15（PR #2368 合并树）

### Checklist
- [x] 已搜索图片分析失败及会话恢复相关 issue；本问题聚焦单次任务失败后的会话隔离，与 #332 的图片格式兼容问题分开跟踪。
- [x] 已提供复现步骤、连续失败截图及错误信息。
- [ ] 已补充完整服务端诊断日志（当前仅保留脱敏错误码，原始请求和密钥不公开）。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem
在对话中发送 JPG 图片后，图片分析任务因 MaaS 侧原因失败。随后在同一会话中连续发送普通文本“你好”，每次都仍然失败，无法继续对话。

复现步骤：
1. 进入 DigitalMate 对话页面。
2. 发送一张 JPG 图片并请求分析图片内容。
3. 图片任务返回失败。
4. 在同一会话继续发送多条普通文本消息。
5. 后续每条消息仍然显示“回复失败”。

实际结果：一次图片任务失败后，后续输入无法创建或继续正常任务，形成持续阻塞。脱敏诊断中可见后续 `room.message` 被拒绝，错误为 `FORBIDDEN: This conversation was reset`。

预期结果：
- 单个图片任务失败只影响当前任务，并显示具体、可操作的原因。
- 后续普通文本消息应能创建新任务并正常收到回复；如原会话已失效，应自动开始新线程或明确引导恢复，而不是在每次发送时重复同一错误。
- 不应通过清除聊天数据或卸载应用来恢复。

### Detailed Environment Information Description
- 应用：DigitalMate，`com.jiuwen.digitalmate`。
- 设备：HarmonyOS 实体手机。
- 云端：Orbit 测试环境 `1.94.211.46`。
- 模型配置：`deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`，经 LiteLLM/MaaS 调用。
- 图片：JPG，截图中附件约 2.0 MB。
- 后续输入：普通文本“你好”，不携带图片。

### Additional Information
该问题与 #332 的图片上传/图片格式兼容问题相关但不应合并：本 issue 关注任务失败后的状态隔离和后续会话恢复。需要分别验证图片任务失败、普通文本任务失败、会话 reset/detached 后的新消息行为，确保任何单次失败都不会永久阻塞后续输入。

### Version Information
v0.1.0（versionCode 10006）。

Track E1 rendering workflow hardening separately from the E1-E3 umbrella issue #571. The four existing cases are DM-WF-MATH-01, DM-WF-STRUCTURED-01, DM-WF-CHROME-01 and DM-WF-QUOTE-01. Implementation: #625.

Use fixed Markdown fixtures and authenticated, read-only inspection of the latest completed task in the isolated test room. Compare actual response content with fixtureEquals, assert UI facts within assistant reply containers, verify scroll movement, and bind quote summaries to their source and user bubble. Preserve case versions, screenshots, UI evidence and source hashes. Provide English documentation for running and extending E1 cases.

Recorded device run e1-571-simple-r3 completed all four cases with 18 passing assertions. The focused Node suites passed 107 tests, and workflow validation passed 23 definitions. Publish the device report and E1 case guide with #625.

### Checklist

- [x] 已搜索仓库内相关 issue，未找到同一问题（相近 issue 已在正文中注明区别）。
- [x] 已在 2026-10-30 内测群反馈中复现/收集到现场证据。
- [x] 已提供截图与可复现步骤。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：用户上传一张普通手机照片（2.1 MB JPEG）并给出简单指令「给我P图，保留锅和食材就可以」，任务直接失败；换成其他提问也同样失败。群内同学排查后定位到两类图片问题：下游 413 与 MPO 格式不兼容。

现场证据（2026-10-30，木稀）：
- 上传 `IMG_20261030_184206.jpg`（JPG · 2.1 MB）
- 回复：「回复失败 云端任务执行失败，请稍后重试；如持续出现，请联系服务管理员。」

群内定位（胡森，2026-10-30 23:19）：
> 22:53:14-22:53:48：连续 2 次 `ModelArts.81029`，下游返回 413 Payload Too Large。请求包含约 1.91 MB 的普通 JPEG，也是同一会话的重试。
> 图片体积大 maas 也有点 bug

关于 MPO（华为手机拍照默认格式）：
- 胡森：「这个 deepseek 原生支持 MPO，maas 的 deepseek 不支持，遇到 MPO 格式，我们做了转换的补丁，会随新版本上线。」
- 夏华梁：「算 maas 上 DS 不支持 MPO 格式图片支持，导致的连锁问题。」
- 期间的处理建议是「清掉所有上下文 / 清空聊天记录后重试」，对普通用户不可接受。

复现步骤：
1. 在选择照片处上传一张约 2 MB 的手机照片（或华为拍照的 MPO）。
2. 输入任意图片处理指令。
3. 观察回复。

实际结果：任务失败；且失败后同一会话的后续请求也会失败（见 #358/#367）。
预期结果：
- 客户端在上传前做体积压缩/格式归一化（普通 JPEG、目标边<上限），把 1.9 MB 级请求降到下游阈值内。
- MPO 格式在端侧或网关侧转成单帧 JPEG，不再依赖 maas 支持。
- 超限时给出明确提示（「图片过大，已自动压缩/请换一张」），而不是统一「云端任务执行失败」。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：DigitalMate（Beebou）手机端 / WorkBuddy 客户端
- 系统：HarmonyOS，截图为 4G/5G 移动网络
- 云端：ADX 测试云 `wss://1.94.211.46/orbit/ws`，Orbit 模板 `v15-workspace-20261028-a974262d1-8ed6d181-no-split`
- 设备型号与 App 版本：截图未显示，待报告人补充
- 反馈来源：DigitalMate 内测群（29 人），2026-10-30（Asia/Shanghai）

### Additional Information

- #332（已关闭）覆盖的是 508 KB / 675 KB 图片分析失败；本 issue 是**约 1.9–2.1 MB** 触发的 413 与 MPO 格式兼容，属于不同根因，建议分开跟踪。
- 服务端错误码：`ModelArts.81029` + 下游 413 Payload Too Large。

### Version Information

- App 版本：截图未显示，待补充
- 云端：ADX 测试云 Orbit 模板 `v15-workspace-20261028-a974262d1-8ed6d181-no-split`
- 反馈时间：2026-10-30 20:5x / 22:53（Asia/Shanghai）

### Screenshots / Recordings

![上传 2.1 MB JPEG 后 P 图请求回复失败](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261030/20261030_2053_large_image_upload_fail.jpg?raw=true)

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.
- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous issue documents：已核对 42 个 open PR 的全部改动文件与 open issue 标题正文，本 issue 的两个目标文件均未被任何 open PR 占用。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：执行过程面板里，网页检索的来源行会把 URL 后面的标点、右括号、方括号一起算进链接，点开是 404 / 空白页，或只弹「暂时无法打开链接」。

**复现步骤**

1. 在手机端发起一次会触发网页检索的问题（例如「查一下……的最新情况」）。
2. 回答完成后展开执行过程，找到「网页检索」分组下的来源列表。
3. 点击来源第 N 条：实际打开一个不存在的地址，或直接失败。
4. 同一来源在结果里出现两次（一次带句号、一次不带）时，「已检索 N 个网页」的数字会多算。

**最小复现（字符串级，`main@7fbaa28`，无需真机）**

```
输入：来源 [官方资料](https://example.com/a)
实际：url = https://example.com/a)
期望：url = https://example.com/a

输入：见 https://example.com/a。其中 3 条
实际：url = https://example.com/a。其中
期望：url = https://example.com/a

输入：**https://example.com/a**
实际：url = https://example.com/a**
期望：url = https://example.com/a
```

第二条最重：匹配用的字符类只排除 ASCII 空白、引号、尖括号、`]`、`}`，中文句号不在排除之列，于是句号后面整段中文继续被当作 URL；来源行标题会直接显示成 `https://example.com/a。其中`。

**根因**：`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/CloudHome/CloudExecutionViewModel.ets:222`

```ts
const links = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>\]\}]+/g) || [];
```

匹配结果不经收尾处理就进入结果集合（同文件 `:223-225`），下游是：

- 气泡内来源行：`pages/CloudHome/components/CloudMessageCard.ets:392-405`，`Text(link.title || link.url)` + `.onClick(() => this.onOpenProcessLink(link.url))`
- 执行详情面板：`pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1996-2001`，`Text(item.title)` + `.onClick(() => { void this.openProcessLink(item.url); })`
- 打开动作：`pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1927-1938`，`openProcessLink()` 只校验 `/^https?:\/\//` 就把整串交给 `host.openLink(url)`
- 计数：`CloudExecutionViewModel.ets:237`（`executionWebSourceCount` 内部 `flatMap(step => executionResources(...))`）、`:254-256`（`executionDetailLabel` 同样 `flatMap(executionResources(...))` + `new Set(...)`）——只有一条数据通路，实测同一来源带/不带句号会被数成 **2** 个网页

**要做的具体改动**（只改 URL 提取的收尾，位置 `executionResources()`）

1. 提取边界与步骤文本遮蔽（#408，`CloudMessage.ets:143`）同一套：排除空白、引号、尖括号、`(`/`)`、CJK 与全角标点区段；另外补回基线本来就排除的 `]`、`}`（`brief()` 只是遮蔽，多遮一个字无害；这里要交给 `openLink`，多带一个字符就是坏链）。
2. 成对括号回接：`https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Function_(mathematics)` 这类括号属于地址，逐字保留；不配平的右括号仍在地址外。
3. 尾部 ASCII 句末标点 `.,;:!?*` 剥掉；路径里的 `/`、`%`、`=`、`&`、`#`、`?` 不动。
4. 其余规则不变：`titles` JSON 配对（查不到标题时回退到未修剪的原始匹配）、文件路径提取、去重、渲染与点击链、`brief()` 的遮蔽规则都不动。

**验收标准**

1. `来源 [官方资料](https://example.com/a)` → `https://example.com/a`，不带 `)`。
2. `见 https://example.com/a。其中 3 条` → `https://example.com/a`；`见 https://example.com/a，然后` 同理不带 `，然后`。
3. `见 [https://example.com/a] 结束`、`见 https://example.com/a} 结束` → `https://example.com/a`。
4. `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Function_(mathematics)` 原样保留（含被 Markdown 包裹时）；`https://example.com/a(b 结束` 只取到 `https://example.com/a`。
5. 同一 `web_search` step 的 `resultText` 含 `https://example.com/a`、`https://example.com/a。`、`https://example.com/a，` 时，`executionWebSourceCount([step]) === 1`，`executionRunTitle(run, true)` 为 `已检索1个网页`。
6. 合法 URL 语法不被截断：`https://cdn.example.com/a/b/%E4%B8%AD?x=1&y=2#part`、`https://example.com/dir/` 原样保留。
7. 既有 `tests/unit/cloud-execution-view.test.mjs` 的 24 条断言全绿；新增断言在未改实现时先红、改后转绿。

**影响面**：只影响「执行过程」面板里从工具文本提取的网址与来源计数；不改气泡正文、不改协议、不改网络行为、不改变任何遮蔽/隐私规则。

**同类路径（本轮不修，只记录）**：气泡正文自动链接已用更严边界 `CloudMarkdown.ets:75`；步骤文本遮蔽的边界在 `CloudMessage.ets:143`（#408 分支）；聚合搜索卡片另有 `HtmlAggregateSearchHomeRenderer.ets:7481 trimUrl`（`:7488-7500`，无条件下剥 `)`，不保留成对括号）；建监控任务侧 `RegisteredPageActionRoute.ets:575` 排除 `，。；、）】》`；探针抓取 `PublicPersonaProbeClient.ets:795` 只 `replace(/[),.;]+$/,"")` 且不进 `openLink`。同一个产品里同一条 URL 有多套边界，其中执行过程这一处明显更松，这就是缺陷来源。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 产品：DigitalMate / Beebou 手机端（HarmonyOS），对话页「执行过程」面板与展开后的详情步骤页
- 版本：v0.1.6，release 路径（问题与版本无关，属 `main` 当前实现缺陷）
- 代码基线：`main` @ `7fbaa283683024cefd0b2354341083b5082781e4`
- 验证方式：`node --test tests/unit/cloud-execution-view.test.mjs`（node v24.22.2，`stripTypeScriptTypes` 直接加载真实 ArkTS 模块），不依赖 ArkUI 与真机
- 未覆盖：真机上来源行的实际排版与点击热区（由 ArkUI 组件决定）；CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 负责编译层校验

### Additional Information

- 与既有 issue 的区别：#407 是执行步骤里裸露 base64 的遮蔽（二进制内容），#484 是表格单元格里的链接不可点（Markdown 表格渲染）；本条是来源网址提取的边界——地址被多截一段，属可用性缺陷，不是隐私或安全漏洞。
- 建议优先级 P3（低风险可用性，不产生新的产品能力）；预估 S（1 个源文件 + 1 个测试文件）。
- 修复分支：`fix/trace-source-url-boundary`，PR #499。

### Version Information

- APP Version：V0.1.6
- 云端：与本问题无关（纯客户端展示层 URL 提取）
- 代码基线：`main` @ `7fbaa28`

### Screenshots / Recordings

当前环境没有真机、也没有截图/录屏工具（沙箱内无 `magick`/`ffmpeg`，无法生成可信图片），按裁定不伪造截图链接。以下是本 issue 可复现的文本对照（同一段工具结果文本在修复前后的提取值）：

```

修复后：url = https://example.com/a

修复前：url = https://example.com/a。其中  ← 整句中文被吞进地址
修复后：url = https://example.com/a

修复前：count = 2（同一来源带/不带句号）
修复后：count = 1，标题「已检索1个网页」
```

如因此被打上 `needs-template`，请以本节与「最小复现」的字符串证据为准；人类可决定是否需要补真机截图。

closed_recent.body:
## 现象
日程/结果场景下助手能生成 SVG，但默认把 SVG 源码整段贴进聊天气泡，而不是渲染成图/结果卡。

## 预期
SVG（及同类生成图形）默认渲染为图片或结果卡；源码仅在用户明确要求「看源码」时再展示。

## 实际
气泡内直接输出大段 `<svg>…</svg>` 原文（可渲染能力存在，但默认走源码路径）。

## 决策门禁
- **Where:** 客户端 Markdown/富媒体渲染 + 云端对 SVG 产物的打包方式（附件 vs 正文）。
- **Problem:** ① 默认渲染图 vs 贴源码；② 是否进结果卡（可折叠「查看源码」）。
- **Conditions:** 未定则继续把源码当正文，长气泡/泄漏感。
- **Impact:** 生活托付/日程卡可读性差，对标结果卡方向失败。
- **Fix:** 建议默认渲染为图/结果卡；源码折叠或按需。相关：#395（未解析协议原文）、#330（DSML 泄漏）、#344（等宽终端原文）、#374/#375（结果卡）。

## 备注
版本：Beebou/DigitalMate。证据截图见评论。

closed_recent.body:
### Checklist
- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version (checked on `origin/main` 1cbee4b).
- [x] Repro and environment below; the visual-evidence field explains why no screenshot of the approval card exists (it is never rendered).

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**结论**：端上唯一「操作授权」决策界面 `ConversationApprovalCard`（跳过 / 授权本次对话 / 授权单次）**从未被实例化**；当 agent 需要用户授权时，界面只显示「待授权 / 需要授权」这类状态文字，用户没有任何可点的授权入口，只能干等或重说一遍。

**背景与证据（逐跳）**
1. 授权卡已写全：`pages/CloudHome/components/CloudPresentationCards.ets:39 export struct ConversationApprovalCard`，`:42 onDecision(action)`，`:49` 标题「操作授权」，`:54-62` 三个按钮 `跳过 / 授权本次对话 / 授权单次`（id 分别为 `digitalmate-approval-skip / -session / -once`）。
2. **断点 1**：全仓没有任何 `ConversationApprovalCard(` 实例化点。对 `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets` 全部 `.ets` 做「export struct → 是否在别的文件被 `Name(` 引用」的扫描（80 个导出组件）后，未被引用的只有 4 个：`CloudWelcomeMascot`、`DebugTextPanel`、`PageStateIndicator`，以及本 issue 的 `ConversationApprovalCard`。同文件另一组件 `ConversationFileCard` 正常被 `CloudHome/components/CloudMessageCard.ets:4` 引用，说明文件本身是活的，只有这张卡没接。
3. **断点 2**：授权需求存在但只有文案。`notifications/TaskNotifications.ets:270` 对 `attentionType === 'approval'` 给出「查看并审批」，可点进去没有任何审批 UI；HTML 渲染侧只输出状态词：`pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlHomeRenderer.ets:3348`（`'授权'`）、`:3613`（`'待授权'`）、`HtmlAggregateSearchHomeRenderer.ets:4996`（`'需要授权'`）、`HtmlDailyBriefHomeRenderer.ets:262`（`'需要授权'`）。
4. **断点 3**：没有替代入口。全仓 `grep "授权|approval"` 在 `pages/` 与 `notifications/` 下只命中上述状态文案与 `train/SystemOneShotScheduler.ets:31` 的通知权限报错文案，不存在任何对话框/弹层承担「授权本次 / 单次 / 跳过」的决策。

**用户故事**：作为让 DigitalMate 执行带有副作用操作（发消息、下单、写日历等）的用户，我需要在它动手前看到一句「要做什么」，并选择「跳过 / 授权本次对话 / 授权单次」；选完要立刻生效且可审计。

**现状与差距**：授权卡组件、三种决策语义、按钮 id 都在，但没有渲染点、没有 `onDecision` 的消费者、没有把 `session/once/skip` 写回会话授权范围的代码路径。

**复现步骤**
1. `git checkout origin/main`（1cbee4b）。
2. `grep -rn "ConversationApprovalCard" digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets` → 只命中 `CloudPresentationCards.ets` 内定义。
3. 制造一次需要授权的操作（如让 agent 发送一条外部消息），观察界面：只有「待授权」文字，没有可点按钮。

**验收标准**
1. 需要授权时在对话流内渲染 `ConversationApprovalCard`（或等价 UI），展示可读的操作描述；`pending=true` 时三按钮可点、`pending=false` 后禁用。
2. 三个决策落到明确状态：`skip` 取消本次操作并给出结果文案；`once` 仅放行本次；`session` 放行到本对话结束（会话切换即失效）。
3. 决策写回后原操作继续或终止，二者都要有可见结果；超时/无响应有确定终态，不悬挂。
4. 审计：每次授权决策有本地记录（时间、decision、描述摘要），可在设置或对话中回溯；不记录 prompt/response 正文。
5. 单测：`onDecision` 三值分发、超时终态、`pending` 下载荷不变；中英双语。

**非目标检查**：不新增权限模型、不改默认授权策略（属产品/安全决策，需人类批准）；不做企业多租户审批流；不引入新依赖；不与 #373（执行中状态黑盒）、#291（失败原因）重复——那两条讲状态可见性，本 issue 讲决策入口缺失。

**风险**：授权语义若接错，会把「需要授权」误当成默认放行（越界风险，P2 支柱）；因此实现必须先有决策落库再放行操作，且默认拒绝。UI 接入点选择要避开被 open PR 占用的文件；提 issue 时 `CloudPresentationCards.ets` 无 open PR。

**优先级**：P1（P2「主动但不越界」的核心闸门）。**预估**：2–3 天（渲染与状态接线 1d + 决策持久化与生效 1d + 审计与单测 0.5–1d）。

**相关链接**：`pages/CloudHome/components/CloudPresentationCards.ets:39-67`、`pages/CloudHome/components/CloudMessageCard.ets:4`、`notifications/TaskNotifications.ets:270`、`pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlHomeRenderer.ets:3348,3613`、`pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlAggregateSearchHomeRenderer.ets:4996`、`pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlDailyBriefHomeRenderer.ets:262`。

### Detailed Environment Information Description
- 仓库 openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate，`origin/main` = 1cbee4b。
- HarmonyOS ArkTS 客户端；`pages/CloudHome/Index` 已在 `resources/base/profile/main_pages.json` 注册，且被 `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:19` 以 `CloudConversation` 组件形式引用，文件与组件均为活代码。
- 组件引用扫描：对 `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/**/*.ets` 中 80 个 `export struct` 逐个检查外部 `Name(` 引用，零引用的 4 个见上文。

### Additional Information
这是「已写好但没接线」的治理闸门，不是新功能。实现时必须先回答「谁触发授权请求、decision 存在哪、下次会话何时失效」，否则容易做成只弹不生效的假修复。PR 需带 `Fixes #本issue`。

### Version Information
- main@1cbee4b；应用版本见 `AppScope/app.json5`（未改动）。

### Screenshots / Recordings
无法提供截图：**该授权卡从未被渲染**，界面上不存在可截的授权面板；可截到的最接近画面是 HTML 渲染出的「待授权」状态文字（`HtmlHomeRenderer.ets:3613`），但那正是本 issue 要替换掉的缺口。证据以第 2、4 条的引用扫描与 grep 结果为准。

<sub>Fledge · DigitalMate · Lead · claimed</sub>
closed_recent.title: [Bug]: 操作授权卡 ConversationApprovalCard 零实例化，需要授权时用户无按钮可点
closed_recent.author: HugoXK

closed_recent.body:
### Checklist
- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version (checked on `origin/main` 1cbee4b).
- [x] Environment and a code-level reproduction are given below; the repro is a static call-graph trace because the UI never renders (that is the defect itself).

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**结论**：客户端已实现「选择要忘记的长期记忆」的界面、数据模型、动作解析器和删除数据层，但**接点全部没有调用方**，用户在任何页面都删不掉一条长期记忆；目标 §2 P3「可治理/可删除记忆」在端上不可达。

**背景与证据（逐跳，写明断点）**
1. 界面已写：`pages/A2uiHome/components/MemoryForgetOverlay.ets:30` `export struct MemoryForgetOverlay`，:7 `MEMORY_FORGET_OVERLAY_SELECTION_LIMIT = 5`，:56 标题「选择要忘记的长期记忆」，:105 上限判定。勾选/取消/确认/isWorking 都在。
2. **断点 1**：它在 `pages/A2uiHome/components/HomePage.ets:2191-2199` 被渲染，`visible` 绑定 `:308 @Prop showMemoryForgetOverlay: boolean = false`。全仓该名字只有 4 处：HomePage.ets:308 声明、:2192 读取、`pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:1133` 另一份 `@State showMemoryForgetOverlay: boolean = false`、Index.ets:6564 读取。**没有任何一行置为 true**；`HomePage({...})` 调用点 `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:8896` 的 props 里没有任何 `Memory` 项。Index.ets:1133 的 `@State` 从未被写。
3. **断点 2**：回调是空实现。`HomePage.ets:466-468` 三个回调默认 `() => {}`，Index.ets:8896 未传入 `onToggleMemoryForgetCandidate / onCancelMemoryForget / onConfirmMemoryForget`；即使 visible 为 true，勾选与确认也不会有任何效果。
4. **断点 3**：A2UI 选择面与动作解析零调用。`model/MemoryCandidateSelectionSurface.ets:71 memoryCandidateSelectionSurface`、`:122 memoryForgetConfirmationSurface`、`:165 memoryCandidatesForgetActionArgs` 在全仓只命中定义处。即使云端推来该 surface（`pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlHomeSnapshot.ets:1547-1571` 有渲染分支），「删除已选」这个 client action 也没有解析入口，按钮点了不会有反应。
5. 数据层就绪且可达：`memory/PhoneLocalMemoryRuntime.ets:406 forget(memoryIds, guard)`、`:534 forgetIfSnapshotCurrent(...)`；后者唯一调用方是 `memory/LongTermMemoryOverviewCoordinator.ets:839`，位于「应用模型纠错计划」中，属于模型代劳而非用户选择。About You 侧只有 `generateOverview / planCorrection / correct`（`pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:4019 / 4051 / 4080`），没有逐条删除。

**用户故事**：作为把 DigitalMate 当长期伙伴的用户，我要在「关于你/回忆」里看到它记住的每一条事实，自己勾选并确认删掉其中几条；删除后它不该再提起，并让我明确知道删了哪几条。

**现状与差距**：三层能力（浮层 UI、A2UI 选择面+动作解析、runtime.forget）互不接线；用户唯一能触发的删除是模型的纠错计划。缺少入口、缺少删除结果面、缺少失败回滚提示。

**复现步骤（静态）**
1. `git checkout origin/main`（1cbee4b）。
2. `grep -rn "showMemoryForgetOverlay" digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets` → 仅 :308/:2192/:1133/:6564，无赋值 true。
3. `grep -rn "memoryCandidateSelectionSurface\|memoryCandidatesForgetActionArgs\|memoryForgetConfirmationSurface" digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets` → 仅定义处。
4. 期望：About You/回忆里有「忘记某些记忆」入口。实际：不存在。

**验收标准**
1. 从 About You（或回忆页）可进入「选择要忘记的长期记忆」，逐条显示 `fact` 与 `personaTag`；候选为 0 时有空状态。
2. 可勾选 1..5 条（>5 禁止并提示上限），确认后调用 `PhoneLocalMemoryRuntime.forget(ids, guard)`；成功后刷新 overview、清除 `MemoryOverviewCacheStore` 缓存，并展示删除结果面（复用 `memoryForgetConfirmationSurface` 或等价 UI）。
3. 失败路径：可读错误、原数据保留、不允许静默成功；取消不改动数据。
4. 单测：选择上限、`memoryCandidatesForgetActionArgs` 非法 args 返回 null、删除失败的状态收敛；须能在 `node --test tests/unit/` 真实红→绿。
5. 中英双语（zh 行为字节不变）、无新增权限/依赖/服务端改动。

**非目标检查**：不做「一键清空全部记忆」（不可逆，需人类批准）；不做云端/其他设备删除（只覆盖手机本地）；不改 `MemoryOverview.ets` 数据契约；不与 #425 的文案本地化重叠；提 issue 时 `MemoryForgetOverlay`、`MemoryCandidateSelectionSurface`、`PhoneLocalMemoryRuntime` 均无 open PR 占用。

**风险**：删除不可恢复，必须二次确认+失败回滚，isWorking 期间禁重复提交；只接浮层不接动作解析会造成「UI 能开、点了没用」的伪修复（验收 2 与 4 必须同时满足）；Index.ets:1133 的重复 `@State` 应一并删除。

**优先级**：P1（P3 治理支柱核心；仓库暂无 `goal:P3` 标签，未新建标签）。**预估**：1.5–2 天（接线 0.5d + 删除事务与缓存失效 0.5d + 双语空态 0.3d + 单测 0.5d）。

**相关链接**：`pages/A2uiHome/components/MemoryForgetOverlay.ets:30`、`pages/A2uiHome/components/HomePage.ets:308,466-468,2191-2199`、`pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:1133,6564,8896`、`model/MemoryCandidateSelectionSurface.ets:71,122,165`、`memory/PhoneLocalMemoryRuntime.ets:406,534`、`memory/LongTermMemoryOverviewCoordinator.ets:839`、`pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlHomeSnapshot.ets:1547-1571`。相关但不同：#425（About You 文案本地化，未合并）。

### Detailed Environment Information Description
- 仓库：openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate，`origin/main` = 1cbee4b（2026-10-31 拉取）。
- 端：HarmonyOS ArkTS 客户端（digitalmate/entry）。无真机可截图的场景即本 issue 自身（UI 永不渲染），故以静态调用链与 grep 输出作为证据。
- 运行环境：node 22 + `node --test tests/unit/`（仓库既有单测入口）。

### Additional Information

closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] 已提供截图、时间点与可复现路径（同一会话内连续失败）

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象：一次任务失败后，失败信息本身进入了会话上下文，后续任务继续在这个失败上下文里执行，于是连着失败。**

这不是「偶发一次失败」，也不是单纯的「上下文丢失」，而是一个写回问题：失败轮次没有被隔离成一次失败事件，而是以某种形式留在了会话里，下一轮仍然接着它跑。

**用户侧可见证据**

1. 失败会**连续出现**，换话题、换措辞也一样：
   - 20:35 发「分析下昨晚英伟达暴跌的深层次问题」→ 回复失败；改成「说错了，是盘后英特尔的股价跌了20%+」→ **仍然回复失败**。
   - 20:16 更是先出现「模型服务出错，回复没能生成」，用户紧接着重问同一个问题 → **回复失败**。
2. **助手自己能看到上一轮的错误**。20:16 那条回复说：「之前你问东非行程的时候，其实我这边是准备回答的，但那一轮遇到了模型服务出错，回复没能生成……是那次请求中途断掉了。」——说明错误信息已经作为会话内容被模型读到了，而不是仅仅展示给用户。
3. 20:24 再问之前聊过的内容时，助手说「之前的聊天记录和记忆里都没有翻到……可能当时那轮对话没有正常保存下来」——失败轮次既没留下可用的内容，又留下了失败的痕迹，后续轮次就在这种半截状态上继续。

截图：

1. ![20:35 连续两条云端任务执行失败](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261030/20261030_2035_cloud_task_fail_twice.jpg?raw=true)
2. ![20:16 上一轮模型服务出错，重问后再次失败](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261030/20261030_2016_east_africa_no_reply_then_fail.jpg?raw=true)
3. ![20:20 生成图片请求失败](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261030/20261030_2020_image_generation_fail.jpg?raw=true)
4. ![20:24 失败轮次后的会话状态](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261030/20261030_2024_context_lost_after_failure.jpg?raw=true)

**复现步骤**

1. 打开 Digital Mate → Beebou / Orbit 云对话（`wss://1.94.211.46/orbit/ws`）。
2. 连续发送需要较长执行时间的任务类提问（搜索 / 分析 / 生成图片）。
3. 等到出现一次「回复失败 / 云端任务执行失败」。
4. 紧接着发下一条（换话题、换措辞都可以），观察是否继续失败。
5. 恢复后再追问失败那一轮的内容，观察助手是否只记得「出错了」而拿不到正文。

**实际结果**

- 失败会**连续传播**：失败轮次之后的下一条消息仍以同样的方式失败（20:35 两条都是）。
- 失败信息进入上下文：助手会主动复述上一轮的错误（20:16），说明错误文本参与了下一轮的模型输入。
- 失败轮次没有可用的正文，但也不是干净地回滚：会话处在一个既没有内容、又带着错误的状态。

**期望结果**

- 失败应作为一次**失败事件**记录（原因、任务 ID、可重试），不得作为正常对话内容进入下一轮的模型上下文。
- 下一轮请求应从干净状态开始，或者显式「重试上一轮」，而不是接着失败的半截状态执行。
- 失败原因要区分（模型限流 / 超时 / 工具未注册 / 网络中断），并给出可操作的文案，而不是统一「联系服务管理员」。
- 失败轮次要保留用户消息原文，便于直接重试。

**影响**：一次失败会把整个会话带进持续失败，用户只能放弃当前会话；对测试同学来说，失败率会被这种连锁放大，无法判断是单次波动还是服务不可用。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 产品：Digital Mate 手机端，Beebou / Orbit 云对话
- 系统：HarmonyOS（截图为 4G 移动网络，20:16–20:35）
- 设备型号、系统版本、App 版本：截图未显示，待报告人补充
- 云端：ADX 测试云 `wss://1.94.211.46/orbit/ws`，Orbit 模板 `v15-workspace-20261028-a974262d1-8ed6d181-no-split`
- 触发入口：Orbit 主对话（非 A2ui 本地 personas）

### Additional Information

**代码路径（v15 源码，供定位参考）**

- `services/agent_bridge/src/orbit_bridge/team_backend.py:1525-1526`：一轮运行失败时只 `log.exception` 并向队列投 `_error`，没有把会话置为终态、也没有清理这一轮在 SDK 侧留下的半截消息。下一条用户消息会直接在这个 session 上继续（`_turn` → `_consume`）。
- 同一文件 `:1326` 只有用户消息会进 `session.history`，失败的助手回复不会补一条终态；也就是说桥接层认为「这一轮没发生过」，但 SDK 的会话 checkpoint 里这一轮已经写了一半。
- 失败后下一轮仍复用同一个 `session.team_name / session_id`，因此半截状态（例如已发出但没有返回结果的工具调用）会被带进下一次模型请求。

**集群只读日志里同时看到的错误（时间吻合，尚未按 task id 对齐）**

1. 模型网关 **HTTP 429**：`litellm.RateLimitError ... ModelArts.81114: Too many requests, the rate limit is 2000000 tokens per minute`，随后 `The memory model is unavailable, so task-... changed no memory`——对应 20:24「翻不到记录」。
2. **ConnectionError** 导致拿不到话题标签（`No topic label for task-...`），会话被留在当前话题。
3. **图片工具未注册**：`gated tool native_generate_images (...) is not registered with the runtime`——20:20 的生成图片请求必然失败，但模型仍回答「可以生成图片」，属于误导性承诺。

**与相邻 issue 的区别**

- #315 是「同一个搜索 query 概率性失败」，单轮问题；本 issue 关注失败如何进入上下文并把后续轮次一起带崩。
- #250 / #254 也涉及上下文，但触发路径是跨轮改写和技能枚举，与本 issue 的「失败写回」不同。

**需要补充的证据**

- 失败回合的实时活动任务 ID 与云端任务日志，用于确认失败轮次在 SDK checkpoint 里留下的具体形态
- App 版本与构建号

### Version Information

- App 版本：待补充（截图未显示）
- 云端 Orbit 模板：`v15-workspace-20261028-a974262d1-8ed6d181-no-split`
- 失败时间：2026-10-30 20:16 / 20:20 / 20:24 / 20:35（Asia/Shanghai）

closed_recent.body:
### 🚀 Background Description


手机端个人 Agent 只需要少量办公类技能，但 WorkSwarm 当前默认安装 15 个技能（含 9 个技能/Agent 创建器、部署引导、研发评测类），并且保留了一套仅供浏览器技能广场使用的上传/导入入口，以及启动期的 Hub 目录预热与 Symphony 技能检索。

对手机产品来说这些能力：
- 常驻 system prompt，占用上下文并抬高技能误选率；
- 启动期产生 Hub 出网请求与缓存写入，私有化部署还要依赖公网可达；
- 暴露 zip 上传/解压入口，属于不必要的高风险面。







### Design Ideas

1. **默认技能集收敛到 6 个办公技能**：docx-pro、xlsx、pdf-extraction、pptx-generator、local-doc-ocr、financial-document-parser。
2. **不做破坏性删除**：旧镜像装的技能在存量工作区移到 `skills/.retired/`（隐藏目录，扫描跳过），用户自装（非 builtin 来源）不动；迁移名单由「旧默认集 − 当前默认集」推导，避免两份名单漂移。
3. **打包层面删除 17 个研发向/重复技能**，保留 17 个（6 默认 + 11 按需），按需技能可通过 `install_skill(source="builtin")` 安装后立即可用。
4. **移除 Web 技能上传入口**：三个 `/file-api/skills/*` 路由、Web 通道三个方法白名单条目、`skills_multipart_http.py` 模块；AgentServer 侧 RPC 保留（TUI/调试仍可用）。
5. **两个运行时开关默认关闭**（env 可回退）：
   - `JIUWENSWARM_HUB_PRELOAD=0`：跳过启动期 4 类目录 + 缩略图 + 推荐的 Hub 预热；
   - `SYMPHONY_SKILL_RETRIEVAL_ENABLED=false`：技能改为 `skill_mode=all`，描述直接进 prompt，不再挂 `skill_index` 与检索 rail。
6. **来源登记**：改动以 `UPSTREAM import_overrides` + 删除 manifest 记录 + 显式 modifications 说明的方式登记，`verify_sources.py` 通过。

### Involved Public APIs

- 无新增公共 API。
- 移除 Web 侧 HTTP 入口：`POST /file-api/skills/upload-temp`、`/file-api/skills/import`、`/file-api/skills/create-from-knowledge`（现在返回 404）。
- 移除 Web 通道 WS 方法：`skills.import_local`、`skills.import_upload`、`skills.create_from_knowledge`（返回不支持）。
- 环境变量新增两个可回退开关：`JIUWENSWARM_HUB_PRELOAD`、`DIGITALMATE_SKILLS_PRUNE`（迁移开关）。
- 手机端协议 `/digitalmate/ws`（`attachment.upload` / `artifact.read`）**不受影响**。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- `harness/personal-agent`（bot-agent）：launcher 增加迁移与开关设置；工作区/会话/产物链路不变。
- `harness/workswarm`：默认技能名单、打包资源、Web 通道、marketplace 预热、技能检索行为。
- 手机端 App：无改动，无需重新发版。
- 部署：own 模式（`DIGITALMATE_WORKSWARM_COMMAND`）才会执行迁移与开关；external 模式（`DIGITALMATE_WORKSWARM_WS`）需在外部实例上配置。





### Test Design and Test Plan

**自动化**
- 新增 `tests/test_workswarm_launcher_skills.py`（15 用例）：
  - 默认名单与上游 `utils.py` 一致、默认技能都存在于包内；
  - 退役名单 = 旧默认 − 当前默认，且与当前默认不重叠；
  - 上游仍读取我们 pin 的两个 env 开关；
  - `prune_retired_skills`：只退役 builtin 来源、保留用户自装、幂等、可关闭、无状态文件时安全、清理悬空记录；
  - `disable_skill_retrieval` / `disable_hub_preload`：默认关闭且部署可覆盖。
- `python -B harness/verify_sources.py`：workswarm 2570 文件、agent-core 2894 文件均 OK。

**手工验收（部署后）**
1. 新实例技能目录仅 6 个；存量工作区启动日志出现 `[digitalmate] retired default skills: ...`；
2. 启动日志 `current skill_mode: all`，工具表无 `skill_index`；
3. 启动期无 Hub 出网；`/file-api/skills/*` 返回 404；
4. 手机端新会话问「你安装了哪些技能」，仅列 6 个；
5. 回归：附件上传、产物下载、`install_skill(builtin)` 安装按需技能后可用。

### Additional Information

- 已删除的 17 个技能中，`harmonyos-dev-suite` 的“安装套件”入口与 `dynamic-memory-cli` 被 `memory_cli.py` 引用，属于 latent 依赖；本方案已将两者**保留打包但不默认安装**，相关入口恢复可用。
- `baoyu-image-gen` 依赖各厂商自有 API Key 与 bun/npx，不读平台模型配置，因此移出默认加载但保留打包。

items.title: test(runtime): verify question continuation with named Office artifacts
items.author: Jianyu010
items.head: codex/nov9-interactive-office

items.body:
The frozen client loads earlier history with `room.messages {room_id, before}`. The preceding room slice rejects that cursor and stops admitting new submissions after 128 per room.

Add the observed legacy cursor contract: an empty cursor returns the newest page; an existing same-room message ID returns up to 200 strictly earlier `(created_at, id)` rows, oldest first. Missing and foreign-room cursors reject. The Gateway retains all owner/M-to-room navigation intents and obtains history through the public scoped Runtime reader. It limits each message page and the in-memory projection window, without a default lifetime submission or room cap or deletion of accepted history. Older artifact reads still go through the public scoped artifact reader. Add a compatible secondary index to known version-1 navigation databases without dropping placement data.

Validation on the #637 base: 31 mobile Gateway UT and 40 real-WebSocket/component ST pass. The large-history test submits 205 real Runtime messages (410 rows), verifies 200+200+10+empty pages, rejects cross-room and cross-owner cursors, preserves all 205 placement records, bounds the retained projection, reconstructs Gateway/Runtime/Manager/SQLite and repeats pagination. Separate tests cover equal-timestamp ID ties, old-task artifact scope, safe absence cleanup, and the existing Office WSS path. Legacy 7c458d66 source and read-only private QA probes established the original cursor behavior.

**Dependency and review scope:** #637 remains draft and must merge before this PR. The requested target base is `codex/architecture-foundation`, so the current diff also contains #637; review this paging change separately as commit `1cb0a26322fcb76f08ccd95c9e5b5a0d71eee590` on exact #637 head `00e8643486fbffa9473a7e09e669978fdfe96f30`. Do not merge this PR before #637. This branch does not modify the mobile binary, driver or the running candidate. Each page/history scan currently performs O(N) public per-submission reads; scale and latency are unverified. The public Runtime interface does not provide a cross-submission snapshot version, so atomicity during concurrent changes outside this Gateway cannot be claimed. Unknown terminal timestamps remain numeric zero and sort before known timestamps. Further independent review and frozen-consumer/device evidence are required.
items.title: feat(mobile-gateway): page durable room history
items.author: Jianyu010
items.head: codex/nov9-room-paging

items.body:
Frozen 7c quoted sends use task.create with an exact reply_to object and a separate latest-thread follows hint. Existing sanitized candidate QUOTE01/02 traces return UNSUPPORTED. This evidence-only draft reproduces that failure through the exact frozen route/Home/DigitalMateClient consumer and a real isolated WebSocket/current Gateway. Production code, #640, shared types and the device are untouched.

Two missing contracts prevent a safe thin adapter:

- Gateway wire messages use projected answer:<R>/user:<R> identities while Router reply_to resolves originating M. Public Runtime history reads require owner+M; no public authorized wire-message→M/part resolver exists. Passing the projected ID to Router fails stale_reference before classification. This draft does not derive identity by splitting IDs or read private navigation maps.
- Even with the correct M directly supplied, two isolated same-S histories selecting EARLY versus LATER produce identical actual ModelGateway HTTP inputs for the same follow-up. Routing to S does not preserve the selected source/part in model context.

The proposed contract in docs/specs/quote-reference-proposal.md assigns authorized publication/room lookup to Gateway, target S to Router, atomic selected-message/version/input sealing to Manager/Store, and shared quote input consumption to HostAPI context.read. It covers distinct same-S quotes, part, revocation/lease ordering, duplicate M/conflict/lost receipts, parent removal and old-data compatibility. It is proposed only; authority lease and shared input types require owner review before implementation. Routing-classifier traffic is explicitly distinguished from execution-model traffic.

Validation on architecture base 6be8867e7f1ca3f9a2b1a2b76e7f0ce04fd963c5: 10 explicit contract/caller probes plus 30 existing Gateway UT passed, zero skips, 2.303s in pinned delivery Python 3.13.16. Additional private actual Runtime/Router/Manager/SQLite/public ModelGateway/OpenAITransport probe records identical complete payloads for distinct quotes. Wrong owner/missing source/wrong room guards, exact-M replay without new inference and changed-quote-M conflict are verified current-contract behavior, not an implemented quote adapter. The HTTP model provider/classifier and native socket are controlled; no Core/agent-path quote acceptance or new phone success is claimed.

The source compiler verifies five exact 7c files and emits source/expression/bundle hashes. It runs only explicitly with a generated bundle outside the repo; normal test discovery adds no new dependency. Private device artifacts and user images are not copied into this PR.
items.title: test(mobile-gateway): document quote reference contract gaps
items.author: Jianyu010
items.head: codex/ws07-quote-adapter

items.body:
The current authenticated aiohttp transport rejects a legal 788,083-byte PNG at its 64 KiB complete-message limit. Raising that global limit also delivers a 900,050-byte ordinary-shaped message before an action check. This evidence-only draft records those real-WS counterexamples and an isolated, optional wsproto admission experiment. It changes tests/docs only; production startup, Gateway, rooms, transport and dependency lists are untouched.

The experiment authenticates before upgrade, applies a hard declared-frame ceiling, identifies the frozen 7c upload action within a bounded prefix, checks server owner/room authority, rejects duplicate keys/compression, and accounts for fragmentation, deadlines and concurrent retained-input reservations. The frozen client request/reply consumer reaches the actual attachment adapter, Runtime and private SQLite, preserving PNG hash through typed input sealing and HostAPI Revision 3. Model/tool calls are zero. This is a controlled component result, not a HAP/phone result or approval to replace the production stack.

Validation on architecture base `1343987e0d22e77a632e5b32e9c696bafc8fc837`: 60 tests passed, zero skips in 18.912s in the delivery Python 3.13.16 image (6 policy, 12 prototype real-WS, 3 isolated-process WSS/capacity, 9 existing-transport audit ST, 30 existing Gateway UT). Independent review reproduced retained-message/deadline counterexamples and verified their fixes; it separately reran the capacity probes and injected readiness failure to confirm process/temp cleanup. Experimental wsproto/h11 wheels are hash-pinned, MIT, installed only into an isolated temporary target. Explicit `probe_` modules keep the dependency and private QA comparison optional.

Additional measured evidence:

- Exact 5 MiB PNG through frozen consumer, verified WSS, existing QA Authority implementation, actual attachment worker/Runtime/HostAPI: Revision 3 and native SHA match; model calls 0. The generated fixture uses a valid private ancillary chunk to reach the exact image byte ceiling.
- Exact 10 MiB CSV staging preserves SQLite BLOB length/hash; 10 MiB + 1 rejects with no second source. This is upload acceptance, not CSV parsing/model acceptance.
- Emulated 64 KiB fragmentation requires 107 frames for the 5 MiB PNG envelope. The candidate's 32-frame policy closes 1009 at frame 33. This compatibility counterexample is retained, not silently tuned away; native HAP fragmentation is unknown.
- Separate server-process RSS baseline 58,316 KiB; high-water 137,884 KiB for the image workload and 149,912 KiB for CSV. This includes Runtime/SQLite/TLS/durable state and is not a concurrent/adversarial capacity guarantee.
- Existing QA Authority class is source-hash checked, with fresh random test credentials and no live state/session/token copies. Unknown CA and incorrect hostname fail certificate validation; bad bearer/binding return 401 before WS data/application/source work. That actual available QA Authority is synthetic; production AGC/account authentication is not established.

Open decisions: canonical JSON order is narrower than general JSON equivalence; public Extension header-policy usage needs upgrade/maintainability review; native fragmentation, production authority and adversarial/concurrent memory/backpressure remain unverified. No HAP/phone success, production stack replacement or deployment approval is claimed. All production code/dependency lists remain unchanged.

**What type of PR is this?**

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:
Task paths and memory projections currently change the system prompt ahead of conversation history, preventing reuse of the matching history prefix. Keep directory rules and memory protocol in the system prompt; append literal directory bindings and dynamic memory data through the existing prompt attachment manager.

- runtime.directories carries actual cwd/project/task/internal paths; rules contain no per-request directory values. Execution cwd binding is unchanged.
- Split memory data into independent history-location, published-snapshot and relevant-memory sections. Query-only updates append only the changed retrieval section, not another unchanged full snapshot. Canonical JSON has deterministic key order.
- Preserve prior context messages, full restoration after compaction, memory fields and conflict policy. Clear active memory sections when disabled and directory bindings when switching away from local-directory channels.
- Retain the previous system-tail rendering for legacy hosts without a prompt attachment manager rather than silently dropping context.
- Record the customized source blobs/tree in harness/UPSTREAM.json without rewriting the original import manifests.

Scope deliberately limited to these two structural changes. No provider cache switches, cache prewarming, memory-retrieval pruning or model benchmarking.

items.head: perf/stable-prefix-attachments

items.body:
## Summary

The current user message is already present in the conversation, but eternal-conversation prefetch also copies the full query into the system memory projection, including when no memories match. Omit only that model-facing duplicate while retaining the original retrieval query, durable audit, matches, snapshots, conflict rules and publication boundaries.

Each model evidence envelope also records the current canonical prompt-template hashes, including failed attempts and reopened legacy sessions. Existing session source manifests and historical evidence remain unchanged; no prompt versions are guessed or backfilled. This preserves creation provenance while making post-upgrade model attempts auditable.

Also shorten the repeated UI-only `call_goal` description. Keep the field optional, preserve the conversation-language and business-field constraints, and leave schema injection and pre-execution argument stripping unchanged. All existing direct tools and their execution/permission contracts remain available.

The two input reductions are separate commits; a follow-up adds per-attempt prompt-version evidence. WorkSwarm import overrides and tree identity are recorded without changing the original upstream manifests; agent-core and unrelated benchmark/helper fixes are unchanged.

## Validation

- Pinned-dependency isolated harness regression with `WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1`: **27 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**. Exercises actual memory Rails/audit, reopened legacy-session and failed-attempt provenance, revision updates, context boundaries, 24-tool model-schema copying and UI argument stripping into an unchanged business function. Real HTTP is disabled.
- `python -B harness/verify_sources.py`: **2,570 WorkSwarm + 2,894 agent-core files verified**; staged WorkSwarm Git tree matches `imported_git_tree`.
- `node --test tests/unit/st-live-wire*.test.mjs`: **42 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped** (isolated checkout with the existing `ws` dependency).
- `git diff --check`: passed.

### Rebase onto current `main`

Upstream `main` has now moved five times while this PR was open. The branch is replayed onto `291c0c8efff8ff52ae8313d3bfb571a8c5c44177`:

| Commit | Subject |
|---|---|
| `e3121fd4` | perf(workswarm): omit duplicate query from memory prompts |
| `0df30d2e` | perf(workswarm): compact repeated call goal guidance |
| `83e3c83b` | fix(workswarm): record prompt versions on model evidence |
| `744fb894` | test(workswarm): align memory prefix test with query omission |
| `2023105a` | build(harness): derive UPSTREAM.json identities with a checked tool |

Conflict resolution notes:

- Upstream `a77f7706` independently split `prompts.py` into `render_memory_protocol()`, `render_memory_projection()` and `render_memory_context()`. This PR adopts that upstream structure and applies only its own behaviour: the duplicated current query is dropped inside `render_memory_projection`.
- `rail.py` imports the union of both sides (`prompt_hashes`, `render_memory_projection`, `render_memory_protocol`).
- Upstream's `harness/tests/test_memory_prompt_prefix.py` asserted that `"query"` must appear in the projection tail, contradicting this PR's intent. `744fb894` changes that one assertion to require the omission explicitly; every other field must still sit after the stable prefix, and the conflict protocol, action gate and v1/0.4 wording are still asserted.
- Upstream keeps gaining overrides (now including `send_file_to_user.py` and a lazy tool-export `__init__.py`); `harness/UPSTREAM.json` takes upstream's structure wholesale and adds only this PR's entries.

Final diff against `main`: 9 files, +571/−15.

### Why `harness/UPSTREAM.json` conflicted every time

`imported_git_tree` and every `import_overrides[*].git_blob` restate bytes that already exist in the tree. Any upstream edit to a customized file rewrites exactly the lines this branch rewrites, so a branch that customizes that same file conflicts on those lines on every rebase — there is no real disagreement to negotiate.

Resolving it by hand is what produced CRLF churn, trailing whitespace and duplicated prose in earlier revisions of this branch. Three things now prevent that:

- `harness/update_upstream_ids.py` recomputes both derived fields from file bytes with the verifier's own pure-Python Git object rules, needs no index or checkout state, writes the file byte-exactly, and refuses to write when a field cannot be computed. `--check` reports stale values without writing.
- `harness/tests/test_upstream_ids.py` pins that stored identifiers equal the working tree and that the file stays byte-stable under its own serialiser (LF, no BOM, no trailing whitespace, trailing newline).
- The conflict resolution takes upstream's version from the index stage rather than from the marked-up file, then re-applies only this branch's overrides.

The full flow was rehearsed against a synthetic upstream edit to `prompts.py`: three conflicts resolved without manual editing, then `update_upstream_ids.py` brought the identifiers current and the verifier passed.

Verification on head `2023105a`:

- `python -B harness/verify_sources.py`: **passed**; WorkSwarm tree `b690d0bb...`, agent-core tree `45b51b70...`.
- `python -B harness/update_upstream_ids.py --check`: **current**, no stale derived fields.
- `harness/tests` discovery: **74 run, 35 skipped, 4 errors**. All four are `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pydantic'` in `test_tool_index_reuse`; this sandbox lacks the pinned runtime dependencies. The same four errors occur on unmodified `main` `291c0c8e`.
- `test_prompt_compaction.py` (19), `test_memory_prompt_prefix.py` (5), `test_upstream_ids.py` (4), `test_verify_sources.py` (10): **all passing**.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- The Node `st-live-wire` suite cannot run here (`node_modules` absent); its 42-pass result predates these rebases. This PR touches no Node sources.
- `node-ut`, `server-regression` and `ArkTS Code Check` passed on the previous head `48c9b8ef`; CI is re-running for `2023105a`.

A real-model server comparison was completed on 2026-11-05 against **`d6267623`**, which is now superseded. Those measurements are historical and were **not** re-run on the rebased head; see the section below.

No linked issue; this follows the prompt-footprint investigation.

## Real-model server validation (2026-11-05, historical — pre-rebase head)

**Result: real requests are smaller; this sample does not establish a stable TTFT improvement or behavioral equivalence.** Applies to baseline `9bef53ee` versus PR head `d6267623` only, not to the current rebased head.

### Setup

- Existing internal MaaS route, `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`, in `adx-jiuwen-test-0`. Both arms used the same temporary Pod/node, 4 CPU / 8 GiB, and image digest `sha256:10de3e3eb648fcb1a3c1714ea3fc2a16ec0f8660fde897f3717f783b02f23727`.
- Both arms used identical copies of the installed WorkSwarm package, differing only in the three PR implementation files (`prompts.py`, `rail.py`, `tool_display.py`); import paths and file hashes were verified inside the Pod.
- Eight real product tasks: two samples per arm per case, in adjacent baseline→PR and PR→baseline order. Each used a new session with an already warm process; no warmups or task retries. SHORT-CODE reused the repository code task and grader; LONG-EDIT extended the repository edit task with a roughly 20 KB query as a stress variant, using its original grader. This is a targeted comparison, not a full benchmark score.

### First-request input size

Counts below were observed on the real product request path. Byte counts are UTF-8 bytes, not characters; token counts come from provider usage.

| Case | Request body, baseline → PR | System text, baseline → PR | Tool schemas, baseline → PR | Prompt tokens, baseline → PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SHORT-CODE | 131,760 → 102,382 B (−29,378 B) | 54,175 → 33,480 B | 55,553 → 47,112 B | 30,134–30,166 → 24,017–24,051 (~20% lower) |
| LONG-EDIT | 173,016 → 122,828 B (−50,188 B) | 74,621 → 33,480 B | 55,553 → 47,112 B | 40,909–40,951 → 29,436–29,474 (~28% lower) |

### First-request TTFT

TTFT means the first nonempty model delta. All eight samples first emitted a **reasoning** delta; this is not time to the first user-visible answer. Samples are listed in execution order within each arm.

| Case / arm | TTFT samples (seconds) | Interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| SHORT-CODE / baseline | 2.3522, 2.6027 | Median 2.4774 s |
| SHORT-CODE / PR | 2.4359, 2.4905 | Median 2.4632 s; only 14.2 ms lower, within observed variation |
| LONG-EDIT / baseline | 5.6430, **15.3655*** | Second sample was flagged `measurement_valid=false` |
| LONG-EDIT / PR | 3.8872, 2.8851 | Only one complete valid adjacent baseline/PR pair remains |

The valid long-query pair was **5.6430 → 3.8872 s** (−1.7558 s, about 31%). That is one pair, not an established improvement. The other pair was PR 2.8851 s followed by the flagged baseline 15.3655 s; it is retained here but excluded from the valid-pair claim.

\* The flagged run had an auxiliary `CancelledError`; all seven foreground model calls returned HTTP 200. This does not by itself demonstrate a MaaS outage. No foreground HTTP failures were observed, but gateway queue/prefill timing was unavailable, so service variation cannot be ruled out. The much larger all-sample long-query median difference must not be treated as attributable acceleration.

### Correctness, limits and cleanup

- Original repository graders: **PR 4/4 passed; baseline 3/4 passed**. One baseline SHORT-CODE run did not modify the source and failed its existing tests. All eight tasks retained all 24 direct tools. These small samples show no observed PR regression; they do not prove unchanged model behavior across tasks.
- Query deduplication and `call_goal` shortening were tested together. Separate live-model contribution measurements were not run. Provider cache counts also varied; a new session is not proof of a cold provider cache. Later same-session turns and process cold start were not measured.
- The PR-only `prompt_hashes` field was not found in the collected session state/trace. Its runtime emission is **not confirmed** by this run; arm identity was established by implementation file hashes instead. The offline provenance regressions above remain separate evidence.
- The internal gateway accounted for **$1.9399712**, against a $2 task cap; the soft stop prevented optional additional arms. No personal paid key was used and no new provider was added.
- The temporary virtual key was revoked (subsequent access returned 401). The test Pod, three ConfigMaps and one Secret were deleted with UID preconditions and read back as absent; all eight WorkSwarm sessions were deleted and returned `NOT_FOUND`. Task-local DSH sessions and scratch files were removed after retaining sanitized timing/usage/grader evidence and source fingerprints locally. No credentials or private service endpoints are included here.

items.body:
The fixed mobile reset creates a fresh room and selects it from the authenticated `room.home` snapshot. The gateway previously supported only one transient home room, so that prerequisite failed.

Add a Gateway-private navigation index for owner/principal, room display metadata and owner+M-to-room placement intent. The intent is written before submission but does not represent admission. Authorized recovery reads the merged Runtime `read_submission` contract (#638) for actual text, S/R and status; `SubmissionAbsent` produces no invented message, while unavailable or invalid reads fail closed. Restored artifacts come only from the public authorized catalog. The index contains no message bodies or product session/run state. Same M cannot move between rooms while its intent remains, and a room never chooses S. Gateway-observed row times are persisted; an unobserved terminal time is the numeric unknown sentinel 0.

Live submissions are shielded and tracked to prevent concurrent recovery from racing their observer. The private index has a single-process advisory lock. Only expired intents that Runtime authoritatively reports absent, with no active operation or cleanup hold, can be pruned. Visible-snapshot revisions change on visible content changes rather than identical reads. Existing unknown/unversioned navigation schemas are rejected without mutation; deploy with a fresh private `navigation_path`. The early draft index was never deployed in the candidate QA state.

**Compatibility and production-release blockers:** the frozen client sends `room.messages` with a `before` cursor, which remains unsupported; each room is limited to 128 indexed submissions. This draft does not claim complete mobile compatibility or production readiness. Full durable pagination, bounded-memory history and a user-authorized long-term lifecycle remain required. Historical tool events, reply/steer and full artifact lifecycle are outside this slice.

Validation on the clean merged #638 base with pinned images: 29 gateway UT and 36 real-WebSocket component ST passed, including absent versus unavailable, live and stale-read barriers, same-M retry and cross-process replay, room/S cross-routing, safe cleanup and cancellation hold, timestamps, public artifact lookup, schema preservation, and existing Office WSS ST. No device or fixed client source was changed. Independent review and frozen-consumer QA remain pending.

items.body:
## Summary

Makes the runtime dependencies that DigitalMate never starts optional. The image now installs only what the default path uses; everything else lives behind an extra and is imported on first use.

This PR folds #584 (transformers) into #588 so the dependency trim lands as one review.

| Component | Removed from default install | Now behind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| agent-core | transformers | `openjiuwen[local-models]` |
| workswarm | python-telegram-bot, discord.py, slack-bolt, dingtalk-stream, wecom-aibot-sdk, lark-oapi | `workswarm[im-channels]` |
| workswarm | google-genai | `workswarm[google-ai]` |
| workswarm | playwright | `workswarm[browser]` |
| workswarm | chromadb, faiss-cpu | `workswarm[vector-backends]` |
| workswarm | google-adk, google-api-core | dropped — nothing imports or needs them |
| agent-core | pymilvus | `openjiuwen[milvus]` |
| agent-core | anthropic, dashscope | `openjiuwen[model-providers]` |
| agent-core | matplotlib, mermaid-py | `openjiuwen[charts]` |
| agent-core | pyoxigraph | `openjiuwen[ontology]` |
| agent-core | docx2txt, cacheout | dropped — nothing imports them |

## Why the default path stays intact

- Reachability was checked by parsing every module-level import in both packages and doing a transitive closure from the real entry points (`jiuwenswarm.server.app_agentserver`, `jiuwenswarm.server.agent_ws_server`, `jiuwenswarm.gateway.app_gateway`). After these changes the closure contains **zero** module-level imports of any removed package.
- `transformers` is used only by local-model features (guardrail local backend, transformers-backed progressive retrieval, RL/SFT tokenizer helpers), all of which already import it lazily. The only eager import (the veRL SFT dataset tokenizer types) is now behind `TYPE_CHECKING`.
- `gateway/channel_manager/__init__.py` resolves IM channel classes through PEP 562 `__getattr__`, so a channel SDK is imported only when that channel is first used. `app_gateway` already imported each platform module lazily.
- `image_tools.py` imports `google.genai` inside `_invoke_gemini_vision`.
- `checkpointer/inmemory.py` had an unused `pymilvus` import on the startup path; it is removed. `MilvusConnector` imports `pymilvus.utility` at its three call sites.
- `dashscope_embedding.py` now imports the SDK only when it builds a request. This matters because `openjiuwen.core.retrieval.lazy_load._load_openai()` imports that module for every OpenAI/VLLM embedding lookup, so a module-level `import dashscope` would have made DashScope mandatory for OpenAI embeddings.
- `mermaid` was already behind a `try/except ModuleNotFoundError` guard; `matplotlib` is only imported inside functions.
- `agentdescent` and `gitcode-api` stay base dependencies: `openjiuwen.rsi` imports them at module level, and that package is loaded from the workswarm auto-harness path.
- `openjiuwen[all]` / `all-vector` now include the new extras so a full install still installs what used to be unconditional.
- `harness/UPSTREAM.json` records every customized file and the recomputed imported Git trees for both components.

Behaviour change to note: a deployment that enables an IM channel, the Gemini vision backend, a local model or an external vector backend must install the matching extra; nothing else changes. The DigitalMate image builds only the base wheels, so image/video generation continues to use the HTTP-based `visual_gen`/`video_gen` paths, not the DashScope SDK.

## Verification

- `python -B harness/verify_sources.py` — both components OK (manifests, overrides, recomputed imported Git trees).
- Module-level import audit from the startup entry points — 0 imports of the removed packages.
- `python -B -m unittest discover -s harness/tests` — merged with current `main`; the only errors in this sandbox are four `test_tool_index_reuse` cases importing `pydantic`, which is not installed here. Those tests are unrelated to this change.
- Docker-level wheel build was not run locally (the environment has no working build backend); CI/image build will exercise it.

## Summary
Fixes #581 — same-conversation count pacts (“问满十遍…”) and their fulfillment/count were recomputed from a short history window, so after a few quiet minutes the assistant treated an already-fulfilled pact as pending and restarted the count at 1.

This change keeps an authoritative per-conversation `SessionPact` on disk under the workspace (`session_pacts.json`), reconciles it from the **full** thread task history (not `WINDOW_TURNS` / `THREAD_TURNS`), and injects a `[session_pact]` block into every turn’s brief so the model must honour the stored count and fulfillment. Higher persisted counts never roll back on a truncated re-scan.

## Changes
- New `engine_session_pacts` module: parse Chinese/English establish phrases, count multi-trigger hits in one message, durable `PactStore`, `reconcile` + brief injection + `after_run` refresh
- Wired via `engine_stage.MODULES` (after `engine_todos`) using `replace_registered_hooks`
- Allowlist entry in `test_engine_memory_changes` PROVIDERS scan
- Unit tests for parse/count/reconcile/persist/no-rollback/fulfilled brief

```bash
cd harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge
PYTHONPATH=tests python -m pytest tests/test_engine_session_pacts.py -v
```

**What type of PR is this?**
/kind bug

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:
Reduce silent waiting and keep displayed process text stable across tool calls:
- Remove ReplyStream's fixed one-second settling delay; renderable model text is pushed immediately. Markdown/key/trailer filtering remains unchanged.
- Convert WorkSwarm reasoning events into thinking activity with empty detail. The pet progress line uses its existing thinking label; private reasoning text is never sent to the phone.
- Phone: show the first received fragment immediately; coalesce later updates on a 16ms timer and catch up to all received text in one tick. Final snapshots show the full final answer without per-character playback. Preserve row identity, stop behavior, artifacts and late topic classification.
- Cloud: save each tool-preface segment as a durable remark, identify its producing execution in provenance, and emit its committed message ID when opening the next segment. Do not repost a finished answer as commentary.
- Phone: include remark messages in the transcript; retain committed process text until its snapshot arrives, then deduplicate by message ID. Execution provenance avoids duplicates when the snapshot arrives first. Replayed commits cannot overwrite the retained process text with a newer answer.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #373. Improves thinking feedback and preserves process text; expanded phase history and stalled-task detection remain outside this change but issue will close on merge per product decision.

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：
- Tested final head: 4e1a74efa72c6d11f25d497c5e868d2f9d82b348. Current base: b4a22945bb22ae3370d11a23715f52b2841ca173. The existing remote PR rebase was preserved; this final commit was replayed on top and retested. Author remains huben0423-hw.

Includes fake Gateway -> bridge -> phone WS tests for thinking before reply release, no reasoning leak, two durable tool commentaries, and matching message IDs in the snapshot.

An additional engine-service sweep on the earlier base yielded 134 passed, 3 failed; those three failures were reproduced on unmodified cfa4c64b and are unrelated roster/legacy-agent/memory expectations. ## 变更内容

这个 PR 修合入后暴露的 CI 启动/兼容性问题，并增加合并门禁：

1. **Windows 签名步骤的执行策略**
   st2 默认 PowerShell 是 Restricted，`Reject machine-local signing config` 报 `PSSecurityException`。Linux 用 `bash`，Windows 用显式 `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File`。

2. **签名检查的 `git ls-files` ENOBUFS**
   仓库文件多，`execFileSync` 默认 1 MB buffer 不够；`maxBuffer` 调到 64 MB。

3. **优先复用已安装 Node**
   st01 已有 DevEco Node v24.14.1，但 workflow 每次下载 Node 22.13 并卡住。现在优先复用 >= 22.13、带 npm/npx 的 Node，找不到才下载。

4. **`node-ut` 与 `hypium-ut` 并行**
   去掉 `hypium-ut` 的 `needs: node-ut`；`st` 仍依赖 `hypium-ut`，`gate-report` 仍等两个单测 suite。

5. **被取代的 run 不再阻塞新 run**
   `gate-report` 的 `always()` 改为 `!cancelled()`；旧 run 被取消后不会再占着 concurrency 组（PR #615 的“只看到 Code Check”）。

6. **新增 `pr-ready-gate` 合并门禁**
   - 没有 `pr-ready` 标签：直接失败，提示先加标签；
   - 有标签：要求 `st` 和 `gate-report` 都成功，否则失败；
   - 增加 `unlabeled` 事件，移除标签后会重新评估；
   - `push` / `workflow_dispatch` 时该 job skipped（不影响 main 回归/Nightly）。

## 重要限制

当前仓库是 **private + 免费计划**，GitHub 对 branch protection / rulesets 返回 403
（`Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public`）。所以 `pr-ready-gate` 现在只能作为可见检查，
**不能从 GitHub 层面强制阻止手动合并**。升级到 GitHub Pro/Team 或把仓库改为 public 后，把
`pr-ready-gate`（以及 `ArkTS Code Check`、`node-ut`、`hypium-ut`）设为 required check，即可硬性阻断。

## 验证

- 本地 `ci-gate` 测试 15/15 通过；YAML 解析通过。
- 分支 run [42033024497](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42033024497)：`node-ut`（Linux）和 `hypium-ut`（Windows）同时 queued，确认依赖已解除。
- st2 日志确认了 `PSSecurityException` 和 `ENOBUFS` 两个真实原因。

## 注意

- 当前仓库变量 `CI_NODE_UT_RUNS_ON` / `CI_REPORT_RUNS_ON` 指向 Linux；要走 Windows 需删除变量或改成 Windows label 数组。
- 目标分支 `codex/architecture-foundation` 的 PR 仍会因缺少 `build-profile.json5` / `scripts/gate/merge-pr-ready.mjs` 失败。

items.body:
## What this fixes

A turn that stops receiving events while the websocket stays healthy leaves the UI in "running" indefinitely. Reconnect reconciliation only runs when the connection drops (`CloudChatManager.reconcileAfterReconnect`), so a silent turn is never checked and the user is left with a half sentence and no way to tell whether the answer is still coming — the exact现场 in #379 (回复只有「我核对一下具体是谁说的。」，之后无任何输出，也没有失败提示或重试入口).

The session now watches that silence itself: after one minute without any event on a turn that still owes output, the conversation raises a single `warn` notice ("云端仍在处理，近一分钟没有新的输出。可以继续等待，或停止任务后重试。"). It never changes the run state, never fabricates a failure, and disappears the moment the cloud says anything again.

Fixes #398. Fixes #379 (user-visible report of the same quiet-turn hang). See also #373 (execution-time opacity).

## How it works

`CloudSession`:

- `watchQuiet()` restarts the silence clock and drops a shown hint. It is called from `beginTurn()` and on every frame the session accepts in `apply()`, so only a genuine gap counts.
- The timer fires at most once per quiet stretch (`quietHint` latches until the next event), only while `state` is `running` or `sending` — a paused turn, a turn waiting on an unanswered question, a stopped turn and a finished turn all have their own state and never see the hint.
- `settleQuiet()` stops the clock and removes the hint on `finishTurn()` and on `beginTurn()` of the next turn, so nothing leaks across turns.
- The hint is only placed when `notice` is empty: a real error/notice is never overwritten.
- The threshold is a constructor parameter (`new CloudSession(id, quietHintMs)`), defaulting to the exported `QUIET_HINT_MS = 60000`; tests pass a short value instead of sleeping a minute.

No new protocol, no server change, no new dependency, no logging of prompt/response content, no permission change. Rollback is a revert of two files.

## Tests (failing first)

`tests/unit/cloud-session-quiet-watch.test.mjs` — 7 cases, real `CloudSession` through the existing `tests/support/cloud-test-loader.mjs`, no device or backend.

Red first: before the change the suite failed with `assert.ok(session.notice)` — a silent running turn produced no notice at all.

| Case | Expectation |
| --- | --- |
| running turn, no events | `warn` notice containing「仍在处理」, `state` stays `running` |
| output resumes | notice cleared at once, bubble text continues normally |
| turn finished before the threshold | no notice, `state` is `idle` |
| turn waiting on the user (`chat.ask_user_question`) | no notice (`state` is `waiting`) |
| a real notice already shown | untouched (`连接已中断` stays) |
| silence continues | notice does not repeat |
| next turn starts | no leftover notice from the previous turn |

Green after the change: 7/7. Whole `cloud-*` unit set on this branch: 517 pass / 3 fail, and the 3 failures are the missing local devDependencies (`typescript` ×2, `playwright` ×1) that `ut.yml` installs — none of them touches `CloudSession`.

## Non-goals

- No automatic failure state, no new terminal state, no retry RPC: the client cannot verify the turn is dead, and inventing a failure would be worse than the silence.
- No server-side change; if the cloud really stops answering, a proper terminal event still has to come from the backend (#367/#379).
- No change to execution/step presentation (that is #373/#375).

## Risk

The only risk is a false alarm during a legitimately long non-streaming tool phase (#322): the notice is worded as "still working", changes no state, blocks no input, is cleared by the next event and appears once per quiet stretch, with a one-minute threshold. Worst case the user sees one informational line on a long turn.

items.body: Closes #628 ## 问题与改动 DigitalMate 的直接回复和 WorkSwarm 执行路径使用不同的身份来源，复杂任务缺少产品侧解析的人设快照。此改动把助手名称、角色、人设和语言投影为带版本的 `assistant_identity`，在任务边界传入执行路径，供系统提示词使用。 - 任务开始时冻结身份，同一任务的续跑和交互恢复沿用原快照；完成后清理，持久化读取包含容错。 - 直接回复和执行路径均使用产品身份，并约束当前部署的内部框架、模型标识及配置披露；不为回答此类追问调用工具自查。公开技术讨论和已授权的用户设置操作继续保留。 - 对 WorkSwarm 的定制通过 `harness/UPSTREAM.json` 的 `import_overrides` 登记。未修改 agent-core、手机 UI 或工具权限。 ## 验证 - 提示词组装检查：直接回复、有产品身份/无产品身份分支，以及执行路径中英文分支通过。 - 已合并上游 main `cfa4c64b`，合并提交为 `89a55299`。保留上游运行时定制、技能裁剪及模式控制，并合并身份定制登记。 - 合并后现有来源校验测试 10 项通过；对精确暂存树导出的归档进行来源校验，WorkSwarm 2570 个文件、agent-core 2894 个文件均通过；7 个相关 Python 模块语法检查通过。 - 镜像 `v34-adx-jiuwen-test-2` 已构建推送，北京和香港仓库的摘要、linux/amd64 平台及源码版本均独立校验通过。源码提交为 `2477f28a`。 - test-2 已确认启动 v34，镜像包含两条回复路径的新规则。手机后续追问已出现符合预期的回复。 ### 验证限制（待补充） 同一手机会话曾在 v34 下确认内部框架；用户补充披露边界后，后续回答才符合预期，且规则进入了会话记忆。因此现有截图不能单独证明代码改动在未受该补充影响的上下文中稳定生效。尚未完成实际模型请求级取证及独立上下文验证；当前作为 Draft 提交，不能据此标记问题已完全修复。 云端 v34 对应合并前的 `2477f28a`，不包含后续 main 合并提交 `89a55299`。合并后版本尚未重新构建和进行云端回归，需在合并 PR 前补充相应验证。 提示词约束不是严格的信息隔离措施。后续需覆盖直接问答、工具执行前后、历史回复诱导以及公开框架知识问题，确认规则进入实际模型输入且不影响正常任务。 ## 修复前问答对比 ## 修复后问答对比

items.body:
## What & why

Issue #353 asks for a WeChat-style "新消息" experience. The bot review on the
issue correctly found that the floating "↓" button already exists
(`showJumpToLatest` / `jumpToLatest`), so this PR implements only the part that
was actually missing:

- **Unread boundary.** When the reader leaves the bottom of the list, the last
  settled row is recorded. A live stream row is skipped on purpose: when it
  commits it becomes a different row id, and the finished reply must still
  count as new.
- **"新消息" divider.** The first assistant reply after that boundary carries a
  blue "新消息" divider (rendered inside its `ListItem`, so list indices used by
  `scrollToIndex` stay stable).
- **"↓ 新消息" button.** The existing floating button now shows the unread label
  and count (capped at `99+`), plus an accessibility label. With no unread
  replies it stays the plain "↓" as before.
- **Clearing.** Reaching the first unseen reply advances the boundary (the
  divider moves to the next unseen one); jumping to the latest or reaching the
  bottom clears the state. Switching room/topic or changing account resets it.

Nothing changes when the user is at the bottom: the list keeps auto-following
and no hint appears.

## Tests

New `tests/unit/digitalmate-unread-indicator.test.mjs` covers the three states
from the issue (at bottom / reading history / returning to the page), the
stream-row edge case, divider advancement and jump clearing.

`gateway-cloud-ui.test.mjs` loads the new helpers because it exercises
`setFollowLatest`/`render` in isolation.

```
node --test tests/unit/gateway-cloud-ui.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-pending-card-in-stream.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-topic-async.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-notifications.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-stream-presentation.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-unread-indicator.test.mjs
# 184 tests, 184 pass
```

The full `tests/unit/*.test.mjs` run has 5 failures that are environmental on
this machine (missing Playwright browser binaries; `EPERM: fsync` in the
worktree for the AGC SMS tests) and unrelated to this change.

**Not verified on a HarmonyOS device** (no build/device available here), so no
screenshot/recording is attached. Please run the ArkTS check and a device smoke
test before merge.

Fixes #353

items.body:
Closes #242。与 #235 的状态栏内容重叠是另一类问题，本 PR 只处理 Beebou 形象浮层。

## 问题

收起态的 Beebou 是页面 `Stack` 上的绝对定位浮层：头像 `x: '50%'`、名字胶囊 `width('100%')` 居中、提醒气泡居中，三层都在 `topInset` 附近的阅读区上方。列表顶部的占位只在滚到顶部时生效，一旦上滑（#242 截图就是把用户提问滚到最上层再看），消息就从这三层底下穿过，用户无法核对自己刚发的内容。名字胶囊还是整条横幅的点击区，顶部这条横带被它拦截。

## 改动

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/OrbitHome/Index.ets`
- 收起态头像**贴右边缘停靠**：`x: '100%'` + `translate(-52)`，82vp 的盒子里 52vp 可见，其余出屏；可见条同时是点击区（≥44vp 触控标准）。徽标改到可见侧，避免跑到屏外。打开实时活动面板时仍回到面板原来居中的位置（面板里 `Blank().height(72)` 早已为它留位）。
- 删除常驻居中的「Beebou」胶囊。名字 + 进度文案改为**只在 `petCaption()` 非空时**出现的小胶囊，停在头像左侧，外层 Row 用 `HitTestMode.Transparent`，不再拦截顶部按钮；点按进实时活动、长按看进展的行为保留。
- 提醒气泡从屏幕中间移到头像下方右侧边缘，仍可 × 关闭（临时提示）。
- `digitalmate-live-activity` 这个 id 移到头像容器上，`DM-WF-BACK-01` 的选择器不变。

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/OrbitHome/OrbitPetAvatar.ets`
- 空闲时**隔一会动一会**：以静帧为主，每 4–9s 抖动 1.4s（200ms 交叉淡化），三张图常驻挂载避免换源闪动；`aboutToDisappear` 清定时器；`reduceMotion` 仍只用静帧；任务执行中保持连续播放（进度信号）。

## 验证

- 新增 `tests/unit/orbit-pet-dock.test.mjs`：停靠位置、身份胶囊不再横跨顶部且点击不被拦截、空闲抖动节律（用假定时器跑组件真实分支）。三个用例在 main 源码上全部失败，本分支全部通过。
- `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs`：2144 个用例，2130 通过；7 个失败均为本机环境原因（缺 `playwright`、`EPERM: fsync`），与改动无关。
- **未验证**：本机没有 HarmonyOS SDK/hvigor，未做 ArkTS 编译，也没有真机/模拟器截图，视觉与手感需要在设备上确认。

## 已知取舍

顶部横带（抽屉按钮、标题所在）本来就是内容从底下滚过的沉浸式设计，头像停靠在这条横带的右端：气泡正文中间完全让开了，但消息滚到最顶端时仍会从头像下方经过，与抽屉按钮一致。若 UCD 方案要求任何滚动位置都零遮挡，需要把顶部改成真正的布局区（列表不再滚到顶栏之下），属于更大的结构改动，可在此基础继续。#242 的评论提到 UCD 方案还在跟进，允许的话请一并确认方向。

**What type of PR is this?**
/kind test

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

Nightly Simulator E2E 目前只把 `DM-WF-CHAT-01` 的**执行状态**当门禁，AI 评分是 informational（`REQUIRE_AI_SCORE=false`）。因此像下面这些已经修过、但只在截图/`ui/*.json` 里才能看出来的 DigitalMate 对话缺陷，回归时不会被任何确定性门禁拦住。

新增 `tests/e2e/workflow/conversation-gate.mjs`：E2E 跑完后直接读已有证据（`run.json` + `ui/*.json` 的 `visibleTexts` / 节点 `clickable` / disclosure 节点 id），做确定性检查，不占设备时间、不依赖模型评分。

| 规则 | 级别 | 来源 issue | 检查内容 | 证据面 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `internal-payload` | 阻塞 | #306 #256 | 正文不得出现 `Next:`/`Reminder:` JSON、`orbit_*`/`mcp_*` 工具名、`agent_id` 等协议字段 | UI 文本 |
| `transport-leak` | 阻塞 | #138 #136 | 正文不得出现 `wss://`、`UNAUTHORIZED`/`ETIMEDOUT` 等传输错误、V8/Python 堆栈 | UI 文本 |
| `runtime-diagnostic` | 阻塞 | #234 | 正文不得出现子代理搜索指令、`openai-codex` / 终端 `pip install` 等沙箱运行时诊断 | UI 文本 |
| `stale-no-reply-hint` | 阻塞 | #218 | `COMPLETED` 用例不得残留「没有得到可用回复」气泡 | UI 文本 |
| `ai-disclosure` | 阻塞 | #125 | 进入过对话页的 `COMPLETED` 用例必须出现「内容由 AI 生成」 | UI 文本或 `digitalmate-ai-disclosure` 节点 |
| `bare-source-domain` | 提示 | #305 #326 | 来源不得是整段不可点击的裸域名；`--strict` 时升级为阻塞 | UI 节点 `text` + `clickable` |

接入方式：

- `nightly.yml`：在 `Build E2E report` 之前跑 `Conversation gate`，任一条阻塞规则失败即让 job 失败；`Enforce chat-01 execution gate` 改名为 `Enforce nightly gate`，notice 里带上 `gateBasis`。
- `nightly-report.mjs`：读取 `conversation-gate.json`，把结论折进 `gatePass`（`gateBasis` 变为 `execution+conversation`），用例表新增 `Conversation` 列，`nightly-summary.md` 里直接引用违规原文，`nightly-result.json` 增加 `conversationGate` / 每条用例的 `conversation`。
- 结果同时落盘为 `<run-dir>/conversation-gate.{json,md}`，随 `e2e-nightly-*` artifact 保留；本地可复跑：
  `node tests/e2e/workflow/conversation-gate.mjs --run-dir artifacts/e2e-workflow/<runId>`。
- 某条用例如果本来就要渲染内部错误，在脚本顶部 `EXEMPT` 里按用例 id 显式列出规则，不放宽全局规则。

本提交相对首版额外补上 `#234`（有验证截图与合入修复），并标明 UI dump 证据面；其余仍留给后续缺口清单合并，避免弱规则抢跑。

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes #234
Fixes #306
Fixes #218
Fixes #125
Fixes #305
Fixes #326
Fixes #138
Fixes #136
Refs #256

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

```
node --test tests/unit/conversation-gate.test.mjs \
  tests/e2e/workflow/profiling-report.test.mjs
# tests 18 / pass 18 / fail 0

git diff --check   # clean
```

- `tests/unit/conversation-gate.test.mjs`：每条规则的命中与不命中（含 #234 子代理指令 / 沙箱诊断命中，以及普通 `pip install requests` 不误伤）、`COMPLETED` 条件、UI dump `visibleTexts` 路径、`--strict`、空 run 目录必须失败、`nightly-report` 在对话门禁失败时 `gatePass=false`。
- `profiling-report.test.mjs` 的表头断言随新增 `Conversation` 列更新。
- 未在本机跑真机/模拟器 Nightly；门禁只消费既有 `ui/*.json` 证据。
